title: Two more leadership exits take place at Xbox
content: Microsoft's Xbox division has seen two more senior leadership departures this week, continuing a pattern of executive turnover following the Activision Blizzard acquisition. The departures include a VP-level product leader and a head of studio partnerships. Industry observers note that Xbox has lost over a dozen senior leaders in the past 18 months, raising questions about the long-term strategic direction of the division under Microsoft's broader gaming ambitions.
